mutations.before: await record?.({ key: result.key, path: result.path });
mutations.after: void record?.({ key: result.key, path: result.path });
mutations.because: Grok PT-8d 6 (owner, 2026-10-11): one result line per minted render is appended and synced BEFORE the next put. A record that is not awaited lets the next write start while the first object has no record.
command: each created object is recorded before the next render is written

mutations.because: D229: a rollback deletes exactly the recorded keys. A skipped or present object was there before the run; recording it would make a rollback delete an object the run did not create.
command: only a created object is recorded: skipped, present, refused and failed renders are not

mutations.before: await record?.({ key: result.key, path: result.path });
mutations.after: await record?.({ key: result.key, path: result.path }).catch(() => {});
mutations.because: A record that cannot be kept must stop the import before the next write; swallowing it writes objects no record lists.
command: a record that cannot be kept stops the import before the next write, and is thrown

mutations.because: One proof is named by many rows of a report: each distinct path is imported once.
command: the paths are the ones on the rows of the report's assets, each once, in first-seen order

mutations.because: Grok PT-8d 4 (owner, 2026-10-11): renders are written only when this run wrote or skipped the report row; when the row was refused each path is listed as not written.
command: with a refused or a failed report row every path is listed as not written

mutations.because: The error must name the object that was created and not recorded: without the key and path the operator cannot tell which object a rollback must consider.
command: a record that cannot be kept stops the import before the next write, and is thrown

mutations.because: A kept report that is not JSON cannot name its renders: writing none of them silently would lose the campaign's renders without an error.
command: a kept report that is not JSON is an error before any write
